name: SKILL
description: The ability to do something well through learning and practice; craft gained over time

name: RESULT
description: What comes at the end of a process; the outcome that follows from a cause

name: CONTEST
description: A struggle between two or more to see who is stronger or better; a test of strength or skill

name: HAPPEN
description: To come to pass; to take place without being planned or forced

name: DESCENT
description: The act of going down; a path or movement from high to low

name: EVENT
description: Something that happens at a set time and place; an occurrence of note

name: RITUAL
description: A set form of acts done in the same way each time, often with deep meaning; a sacred practice

name: GATHER
description: To bring together from many places into one; to collect what is spread apart

name: PEOPLE
description: Human beings taken as a group; the many who live and share a common life

name: ROTATE
description: To turn around a center; to spin in place as a wheel turns on its axis

name: EVEN
description: Flat and level without rise or fall; smooth and the same across all parts

name: PIECE
description: A part cut or taken from a whole; one section of something larger

name: QUICK
description: Moving or done with great speed; fast and without delay

name: WRITE
description: To set down words in lasting form; to put thought into marks that others may read

name: BOAT
description: A small craft for travel on water; a thing that floats and carries across rivers or seas

name: FARM
description: Land used to grow food and keep animals; a place where the earth is worked for harvest

name: LETTER_ALPHABET
description: A single mark in a written language; one of the signs that together form words

name: LETTER_MAIL
description: A written message sent from one person to another; words carried across distance

name: COURT_LAW
description: A place where justice is given by law; where a judge hears the truth and decides what is right

name: COURT_ROYAL
description: The household and circle around a king or ruler; those who attend the seat of power

name: TRAIN_VEHICLE
description: A long line of cars that move on iron tracks; a way to carry many across great distance

name: TRAIN_TEACH
description: To teach a skill through practice over time; to shape ability by doing again and again

name: RACE_CONTEST
description: A contest of speed; a test to see who can reach the end first

name: RACE_PEOPLE
description: A group of people who share common origin and form; a line of shared blood and land

name: BOARD_FLAT
description: A flat piece of wood cut long and wide; a firm surface used to build or stand upon

name: BOARD_GROUP
description: A group chosen to guide or decide for a larger body; those who sit in authority over an organization

name: RECORD_KEEP
description: A lasting account of what was said or done; something written or kept so the past is not lost

name: RECORD_BEST
description: The best that has ever been done; a mark of achievement that none before have reached
